title: Marimba Rain (Central America Instrumental)
style: Central American marimba pure instrumental bass marimba congas maracas 84bpm warm traditional Guatemala Nicaragua folk no vocals cinematic dancing rain atmospheric textural
lyrics:
[Instrumental — marimba, maracas, bass marimba, congas]

[Opening — marimba high register, single line]

[Bass marimba enters — rich low tone]

[Congas join — light groove]

[Full marimba texture — all registers]

[Rain break — maracas and silence]

[Return — marimba full]

[Fade — marimba alone]
